name: Yu no Machi Kitan
source:
A troubled writer went to a hot spring inn for motivation.

What he found there was a mysterius boy...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/123]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
一名陷入创作困境的作家，来到温泉旅馆寻找灵感。

在那里等着他的，竟是一名神秘少年…？
